purpose: Defines structural effects that occur when selected technologies mature or when a technology-enabled deployment event occurs. Ordinary node capabilities remain declared on the nodes themselves.

biofabrication.description: Mature biological fabrication makes structural/industrial biofabrication a civilization-level research applicability capability.

synthetic_cognition.description: Knowing how to construct synthetic cognition does not mean a machine population actually exists. It enables the civilization to instantiate persistent machine cognition.

whole_mind_emulation.description: Whole-mind emulation provides another route by which persistent machine cognition may actually be instantiated.

persistent_machine_cognition_instantiate.description: Triggered only after at least one persistent autonomous synthetic cognition actually exists. This prevents research alone from pretending a machine population is already present.
